description: This file contains functions and configurations for setting up and managing mac80211 wireless interfaces, including device and interface configuration, capabilities, and driver setup for OpenWRT.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_init_device_config
methods.description: Initializes device-specific configuration parameters for mac80211.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_init_iface_config
methods.description: Initializes interface-specific configuration parameters for mac80211.

methods.name: mac80211_add_capabilities
methods.description: Adds capabilities to a variable based on provided masks and capabilities.

methods.name: mac80211_add_he_capabilities
methods.description: Adds HE (High Efficiency) capabilities based on hardware capabilities.

methods.name: mac80211_hostapd_setup_base
methods.description: Sets up base configuration for hostapd for a given PHY.

methods.name: mac80211_hostapd_setup_bss
methods.description: Configures a BSS (Basic Service Set) for hostapd with specific parameters.

methods.name: mac80211_get_addr
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address for a given PHY and index.

methods.name: mac80211_generate_mac
methods.description: Generates a MAC address for a PHY based on index and base address.

methods.name: get_board_phy_name
methods.description: Determines the board-specific PHY name from a given path.

methods.name: rename_board_phy_by_path
methods.description: Renames a PHY based on board configuration path.

methods.name: rename_board_phy_by_name
methods.description: Renames a PHY based on board configuration name.

methods.name: find_phy
methods.description: Finds and renames PHY based on various identifiers like name, path, or MAC address.

methods.name: mac80211_check_ap
methods.description: Checks if an access point is present.

methods.name: mac80211_set_ifname
methods.description: Sets interface name with a prefix and index.

methods.name: mac80211_prepare_vif
methods.description: Prepares a virtual interface with configuration parameters.

methods.name: mac80211_prepare_iw_htmode
methods.description: Prepares the HT mode for iw based on current settings.

methods.name: mac80211_add_mesh_params
methods.description: Adds mesh parameters to configuration.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_adhoc
methods.description: Sets up an adhoc wireless network.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_mesh
methods.description: Sets up a mesh wireless network.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_monitor
methods.description: Sets up a monitor mode interface.

methods.name: mac80211_set_vif_txpower
methods.description: Sets transmit power for a virtual interface.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_init_config
methods.description: Initializes wpa_supplicant configuration.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_add_interface
methods.description: Adds a network interface to wpa_supplicant.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_set_config
methods.description: Sets the configuration for wpa_supplicant.

methods.name: hostapd_set_config
methods.description: Configures hostapd for a PHY.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_start
methods.description: Starts wpa_supplicant on a PHY.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_supplicant
methods.description: Sets up wpa_supplicant for a virtual interface.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_vif
methods.description: Prepares and configures a virtual interface.

methods.name: get_freq
methods.description: Retrieves frequency for a given channel and band.

methods.name: chan_is_dfs
methods.description: Checks if a channel is DFS (radar detection) enabled.

methods.name: mac80211_set_noscan
methods.description: Disables scanning for a specific interface.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up driver-specific resources.

methods.name: mac80211_reset_config
methods.description: Resets configuration for a PHY.

methods.name: mac80211_set_suffix
methods.description: Sets suffixes for PHY and VIF based on radio index.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_setup
methods.description: Main setup function for mac80211 driver, configuring PHY, interfaces, and associated services.
